headline: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 reaches 18.54% matched code as PAL batches also land
summary: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 rose from 18.25% to 18.54% matched code by size. Its progress report now counts 9,408 matched functions out of 18,172 for NTSC-U v1.00, while the PAL release has 9,724 matched functions out of 18,136. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: #176 adds 15 NTSC-U v1.00 functions in game and network code, also matching on PAL. #179 adds another 56 functions that match both releases.
#177 adds 69 PAL functions and preserves three exact PAL variants.
Seven PAL-only functions cover DreadZone Station, multiplayer menus, game code and shared level code (#178).
Six PAL multiplayer-menu record helpers now match. The separate candidate `func_L00_00533D30` remains a near miss outside the compiled sources (#180).
